name: Alloyed: Steel and Bronze
description: Alloyed adds two alloys and the forge that makes them.

pages.title: Alloyed: Steel and Bronze
pages.text: Alloyed adds two alloys and the forge that makes them. Steel and bronze become tools, armor and building blocks. Both are shared with other mods (see [#](2E5AAC)[Shared Metals](entry://materials/shared_metals)[#]()).

pages.title: Alloy Forge
pages.text: Forges Alloyed tools, armor and parts. Steel and bronze themselves come from a [#](2E5AAC)[heated](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]() Create mixer: bronze from copper, three zinc nuggets and cinder flour. See [#](2E5AAC)[Balance Changes](entry://connections/balance)[#]().

pages.title: Steel
pages.text: Alloyed's recipes now give TFMG steel. Forge it into pickaxes, swords, armor, horse armor, shears and fishing rods; any steel works. [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]() gets a steel knife.

pages.title: Bronze
pages.text: Alloyed's bronze is the pack's bronze: Big Cannons and TFMG bronze recipes give it too. Used for casing, sheet and blocks. Bronze blocks oxidize like copper and can be waxed.

pages.title: Bronze Bell
pages.text: A playable block. It rings when hit or powered by redstone, a [#](2E5AAC)[Wrench](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() tunes it, and a [#](2E5AAC)[Deployer](entry://create_basics/deployer)[#]() can ring it.

**Casings and building blocks:**
- Steel Casing and Bronze Casing, with [#](7A3C9A)[encased](entry://glossary/encased)[#]() shafts and cogwheels, add more tiers to your builds
- Steel catwalks, mesh fences and doors

Old Alloyed steel ingots convert to TFMG steel in a crafting grid. See [#](2E5AAC)[TFMG Steel](entry://industry/tfmg_steel)[#]().
